subject.title: feat: auto-detect provider usage and billing stats

question: Should OpenClaw replace the core `usageProviders` allowlist with provider-owned usage-hook discovery and add a structured billing contract for the Usage dashboard now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable answer affects plugin SDK compatibility, provider endpoint ownership, dashboard UX, and which billing fields become public contract.

options.title: Approve scoped provider-owned billing contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and define the minimal additive snapshot fields, discovery rules, provider coverage, UI cards, and proof requirements before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to dashboard consumption only
options.body: Only load and render existing `usage.status` in the Usage page while leaving provider discovery and structured billing fields for separate provider/API issues.

options.title: Defer broader billing work
options.body: Leave current CLI/status and transcript-cost surfaces as supported behavior until a maintainer sponsors the broader provider billing roadmap.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped provider-owned billing contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define the minimal additive snapshot fields, discovery rules, provider coverage, UI cards, and proof requirements before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is tied to both the provider-usage split and recent Usage UI work, and the remaining choice is primarily product/API direction.
